command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; git fetch origin --prune; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; Write-Output 'BRANCH'; git branch --show-current; Write-Output 'HEAD_BEFORE'; git rev-parse HEAD; Write-Output 'ORIGIN_MAIN'; git rev-parse origin/main; Write-Output 'STATUS_BEFORE'; git status --short; $dirty=@(git status --porcelain); if($dirty.Count -ne 0){throw 'Checkout unexpectedly dirty; refusing sync.'}; if((git branch --show-current).Trim() -ne 'main'){throw 'Expected main branch.'}; git merge --ff-only origin/main; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; Write-Output 'HEAD_AFTER'; git rev-parse HEAD; Write-Output 'STATUS_AFTER'; git status --short
